name: lumendeck
description: Pilotage local d'ampoules Tuya (Calex et compatibles) depuis un Stream Deck.

scripts.test: node --test src/driver/__tests__/codec.test.mjs src/driver/__tests__/color-format.test.mjs src/driver/__tests__/errors.test.mjs src/driver/__tests__/key-art.test.mjs src/driver/__tests__/scenarios.test.mjs src/driver/__tests__/tuya-cloud.test.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && streamdeck dev && streamdeck link com.lumendeck.bulb.sdPlugin && streamdeck restart com.lumendeck.bulb
scripts.pack: npm run build && streamdeck pack com.lumendeck.bulb.sdPlugin --output dist --force
